title: Joy Void-Holmes on Parkell’s TurboSensor+360
html:
In this episode of Speaking of Dentistry… The Editor’s Cut with Stan Goff, Stan Goff, Senior Managing Editor of Dentistry Today, talks with Joy D. Void-Holmes, DHSc, BSDH, RDH, about dental hygiene, ergonomics, and innovations in ultrasonic scaling.

Void-Holmes discusses Parkell’s TurboSensor+360 ultrasonic scaler, highlighting its lightweight design, detachable and autoclavable handpiece, Cruise Control and Purge Mode features. She also shares her perspective on the evolving role of dental hygienists, infection control, and the importance of products designed around clinicians’ everyday needs.

Sponsored by Parkell.

Watch to hear how ultrasonic scaling technology can support dental hygienists and their patient care.
